# SNS

Publish messages to local queues, functions, Firehose streams, mobile endpoints, or confirmed HTTP subscriptions.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `sns` |
| Signing name | `sns` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2010-03-31` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 42 of 42 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#sns) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Email, SMS, and mobile push deliveries are recorded locally, not sent to external providers or push gateways.
- DataProtectionPolicy is validated and stored without performing PII scanning or redaction; HTTP/HTTPS deliveries do not attach cryptographic message signatures.
- HTTP/HTTPS retry delays are compressed locally to keep tests fast; ListOriginationNumbers always returns an empty list.
- In verify mode, console management requires an authenticated root console session; without a session topic/subscription inventory and delivery history remain available.
- SNS metrics omit SMS metrics and delivery metrics broken down by protocol or application; confirmation messages are not counted.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
